name: Wanderer Melodies
author: Freek van Gool
description: Probability-melody presets for Wanderer, grouped by use: lead lines in every mode, basslines, arpeggios and plucks, ambient and slow lines, genre starters, dynamics (ghost notes, accents, crescendo), rolls and ratchets, chord-following lines and evolving patterns. Every preset carries a ready motif, with varied velocities and note lengths.
